method: Explicit bounded source-pixel donor translation; identical repair weights/coordinates for color,normal,roughness. No source file writes, scale/orientation changes or global filtering.

repairs.name: long bright horizontal scratch
repairs.rationale: Recognizable source scratch recurring through every candidate-v1 crop; donor is adjacent intact same-panel paint, at identical pixel scale.

repairs.name: upper bright oval chip
repairs.rationale: Distinct white chip repeats as a recognizable mark; replace only its bounded footprint.

repairs.name: right bright oval chip
repairs.rationale: Distinct recurring pale chip in the old source window.

repairs.name: upper diagonal drag cluster
repairs.rationale: Broad diagonal macro smear is separate from fine paint grain; adjacent lower paint supplies paired intact color/normal/roughness without any rescale.

repairs.name: lower diagonal drag cluster
repairs.rationale: Second identifiable diagonal smear; translation toward center-left avoids the photographed panel seam.

repairs.name: square pale remnant
repairs.rationale: Recognizable square pale remnant enters the lower windows; remove this local motif rather than blurring all coating.

repairs.name: left isolated pale remnant
repairs.rationale: Isolated pale peeling remnant would recur in the lower-left photo sample.

repairs.name: lower paper-like remnant
repairs.rationale: Exclude the source remnant that reads as a photographed sticker/paper fragment instead of generic intact coating.
